source_snapshot.procedure: Physically stall PSU fan with nonconductive flexible object; remove obstruction; check status.
source_snapshot.criteria: Correct sensor/SEL, amber flashing failure LED, green after removal and power-cord replug.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: CRITICAL manual fault injection with guarded fixture, load/thermal interlocks and recovery.

old_problem: Live PSU fan obstruction is a high-energy thermal/electrical fault injection with no vendor fixture, load/redundancy envelope, stall limit, event oracle or hard abort. Procedure ends after removal while Criteria adds a power-cord replug with undefined isolation/live-service safety.
disposition_reason: ED-09 assigns physical work to a qualified operator but does not authorize hazardous PSU interference. The safe fixture, allowed stall and AC recovery are core OEM/electrical semantics, and the remove-only versus replug branch is contradictory. Execution must remain blocked rather than parameterizing an unsafe guess.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2266 and 2267, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical records and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve real fan-stall detection, sensor/SEL, amber flashing fault LED, obstruction removal, green recovery and literal replug criterion.
Require exact PSU/feed/fan identity, redundancy and measured survivor-load margin, vendor guarded fixture and maximum stall duration.
Monitor current, temperature, fan, survivor load and BMC state continuously with conservative hard aborts.
Engineering must choose autonomous recovery after removal versus isolated qualified cord replug and define deassertion/final-state evidence.
No fan contact/stall, PSU/cord action, log clear, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Guarded PSU fan-stall detection with reconciled electrical recovery
test_case.purpose: Validate the exact PSU fan-stall fault path, BMC sensor/SEL and amber LED assertion, then safely remove the stimulus and execute only the approved recovery branch to green healthy status.
required_package: Vendor-approved guarded nonconductive fixture and stall limit
Sensor/SEL/LED timing oracle and isolated no-replug/replug recovery
test_case.test_command: Gate closed. A qualified electrical operator applies the approved guarded fixture for at most the signed duration while synchronized telemetry enforces aborts; capture fan/sensor/SEL/amber evidence, remove fixture, then perform only the engineering-selected isolated recovery branch and verify green LED, fan speed, deassertion and stable load.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped fan/PSU fault asserts within the expected time with exact sensor/SEL and flashing amber indication, stays inside all safety limits, and after the approved recovery deasserts to green with restored fan/load/system health.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires vendor fixture/envelope, deterministic event/LED oracle and reconciled safe recovery. Missing evidence keeps Pending and execution BLOCKED. Wrong event, exceeded limits, unexpected load transfer, non-recovery or damage is FAIL.
safety_gate: Qualified electrical operator, isolated dedicated SUT and independent power/console recovery.
Vendor guarded fixture only; never body or loose object near PSU.
Verified redundancy/load margin and live hard-abort monitoring.
No cord replug unless feed isolation/live-service procedure is explicitly approved; no retry.
expected_evidence: Fixture, stall duration and abort telemetry
Selected removal/replug isolation recovery and green/deassert evidence
test_case.recovery: On any limit or abnormality remove the stimulus if safe, isolate per the signed electrical plan, preserve telemetry/SEL/video and let the authorized PSU owner recover the system; never improvise cord handling or repeat.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure says removal/check only while Criteria requires cord replug; the electrical recovery path remains unresolved.

blocked.reason: Live PSU fault injection is unsafe until vendor fixture, limits and a qualified recovery branch are approved.
